newsitem.title: USA: U.S. warship departs Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: U.S. warship departs Sierra Leone.

text.p: The U.S. Navy helicopter carrier Kearsarge departed from off troubled Sierra Leone on Friday and headed for the Mediterranean, the Defence Department said.

The big warship and its force of 1,200 Marines earlier took part in evacuating 2,509 people including 451 Americans from Freetown, the capital of the West African nation where a military coup had deposed elected civilian leaders.

"The ship departed today and is steaming toward its normal station in the Mediterranean. No more evacuations (from Sierra Leone) are planned by the United States," Army Lt. Col. Nancy Burt, a Pentagon spokeswoman, said.

Defence officials said the evacuees, taken aboard the Kearsarge from Freetown without major incident in three helicopter waves on May 30, June 1 and June 3, had all been subsequently removed to neighbouring Guinea.
